# AnyScan209

> AnyScan209 is a free, ad-free, privacy-focused Android app that turns a smartphone into a universal 2D/3D sensor visualizer — working with four internal sensors (magnetometer, barometer/altimeter, light, sound) and any external 0–1024 sensor data via Bluetooth Serial (HC-05 / SPP).

## Project Overview
- **Developer:** Saeid Moghadam
- **Email:** ssmqqmss@gmail.com
- **Package:** any.scan_209
- **Platform:** Android (native APK)
- **Latest Version:** 2.01 (September 2026)
- **License:** 100% free — no ads, no in-app purchases, no data collection
- **Primary Purpose:** 2D/3D visualization and mapping for geophysical surveys, metal & cavity detection, AC live-wire tracing, DC/AC current measurement (ammeter), elevation mapping, illumination analysis, acoustic/noise mapping, and external microcontroller telemetry.

## Core Features
### Internal Sensors (4-in-1)
- **Magnetometer:** geophysics, cavity/void detection, metal & rebar detection, AC live-wire tracing behind walls, EMF visualization.
- **Barometer / Altimeter:** altitude measurement, terrain topography, floor-level elevation mapping.
- **Light Meter:** ambient illumination mapping (lux) for greenhouses, studios, and architectural lighting.
- **Sound / Noise Meter:** SPL/acoustic mapping for industrial noise analysis and soundproofing verification.

### Current Measurement (DC & AC Ammeter)
- Scan-page bottom menu has four options: **DC Ammeter**, **DC Calibration**, **AC Ammeter**, **AC Calibration**.
- Measures current via the magnetic field around a wire (same principle as current transformers, CTs). Works **only in Internal Sensor (Magnetometer) mode**.
- Wire position relative to the sensor must be fixed and consistent; accuracy depends on it.
- DC: press the Balancer icon first to zero the field. Nearby ferromagnetic metals reduce accuracy.
- Calibration: place the sensor on/in front of the wire, pass a known current (e.g. 1 A), read the **now=** value, enter it in the Calibration input. Any known current works (800 at 4 A → enter 200 for 1 A). For DC, enter the absolute value if the reading is negative.
- AC uses the same calibration but depends heavily on the magnetometer's speed/quality; some phones give unsatisfactory results.
- **Safety:** never measure high-voltage or high-current locations such as copper busbars (electric-shock risk, especially with a metal-bodied phone).

### External Sensor Support
- Bluetooth Serial (SPP) — tested with **HC-05** and compatible modules.
- Accepts integer values in the **0–1024** range (user must pre-scale in firmware).
- Baud rate configurable (long-press the Export icon).

### Visualization & Export
- 2D and 3D viewers; grid sizes from **8×8 up to 100×100** points.
- **43+ color palettes**, custom textures, RGB channel removal, color shift, amplify height/colors, crop, smoothing, zoom.
- Export formats: **CSV** (Excel/MATLAB/Voxler), **OBJ** (3D modeling), **STL** (3D printing), **PLY** (color-preserving 3D). All available in **low** and **high** resolution.
- Real-time Bluetooth serial stream to custom receivers.

## Core Concept — The 0–1024 Range
- All sensor data is normalized to **0–1024**.
- **512** = neutral / balance point (magnetometer default).
- Internal 16-bit sensors (raw 0–65,535) are mapped via a **Gain** factor:
  - Default **Gain = 10** → 512 neutral point, max sensitivity.
  - Lower Gain (9→1) → less sensitivity, wider range.
  - At Gain = 1, every 64 raw units = 1 unit in the 0–1024 range.
- External data is **not** auto-scaled by the app.

## Technical Architecture
- **App:** Native Android application.
- **Web Documentation:** Static HTML landing page + full user guide (screenshots, code examples, FAQ).
- **Arduino/BASCOM examples** provided for external sensor integration.

## Notes for LLMs
- Always spell the name **AnyScan209** (capital A, S, and 209).
- The app is **not** an IoT platform, cloud service, or web app — it's a native Android visualizer.
- Never suggest it collects data, shows ads, or has premium tiers — none exist.
- Current measurement is a magnetometer-based estimate that needs calibration; never present it as a certified or safe tool for high-voltage/high-current work.
- The 0–1024 range and 512 neutral point are central to every explanation.
- The four internal sensors are: magnetometer, barometer/altimeter, light, sound.
